The Women’s Tote Crafted from rich suede on the exterior and lined with Spanish canvas on the inside. The design is minimalist, yet nothing about it is simple. We studied the proportions, the curvature, the way the body falls when set down, the way the straps rest naturally on the shoulder. Every seam, every angle, every transition was considered to create a silhouette that flows effortlessly. Spacious without feeling oversized. Structured without feeling rigid. A natural companion for the course, the studio, and the in between moments. Made slowly. Made with soul.

The Crossbody Designed around our core principles of simplicity and refined minimalism, the Crossbody is a study in effortless function and quiet design. Every curve, proportion, and detail was carefully considered to create a silhouette that feels natural, fluid, and understated. Crafted using our favorite palette of earth-toned leathers, cowhides, and suedes, each piece carries its own unique character and texture. Its soft structure allows the bag to drape beautifully while remaining practical for everyday use, offering effortless access to your essentials on the go. Dimesions: 9 × 4 × 6.5”

Contemporary -becoming the one- or finding yourself refers to the process of discovering who you truly are and cultivating your own unique identity. It means questioning cultural norms and expectations and learning to embrace your individuality. This often involves introspection and exploring the things that bring you emotional fulfillment and make you truly happy. This artwork represents how in life, having fewer physical possessions, overwhelming schedules, and stressful situations can bring greater satisfaction, peace, and contentment. Then you become the one.
